Eg.bar_b_note: The blotch camouflage dissolves the silhouette and face in both sides (worst on A's dark olive/orange), and B's creature shrinks to roughly trainer height, so it reads as a placeholder rather than a Palworld-class creature.

Ln.bar_b_note: Bulky bear mass and scale carry it, but the dark spotted back plates break the silhouette into noise and there is no rim light to lift it off the stage.

Zi.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder with readable eyes and a palette that fits the meadow world; the rounder, more cartoon face sits a little apart from the naturalistic creature style.

Cb.bar_b_note: B's teal body, pale belly and violet fin read far better than A's near-black glossy purple, but both stand barely trainer-high and the face is lost at small size.

Uv.bar_b_note: The fleece-and-horn Stormcapra model matches the owner bar, but B's faint mid and faint end float the creature in mid-air above its own shadow, and A's faint end jams the head into the floor.

Rp.bar_b_note: Spotted blue serpent-dragon has a strong silhouette and A's pale crest is on-palette, but B keeps red frills, drops the ridden frame and its faint end coils upright like a sitting statue.

Zk.bar_b_note: B's larger wrapped recipe text and ingredient rows are readable on the blue-grey translucent panel, but the Craft/Leave actions are body-weight text with tiny generic glyphs and no teal emphasis, and the world behind is murky.

Vv.bar_b_note: A naturalistic shaggy wolf at Tanglevolt-bar finish, clearly taller than the trainer with readable hit and faint poses; only the dark-on-dark value and missing rim light hold it back.

Hd.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing read as built, but it is still a lone thin panel; B is a blown-out white board with no cap or footing, and the flat grey rock and sparse grass sit well below Palworld density.

Nj.bar_b_note: Same blue dragon: B's pale crest and grounded flat faint carry it, while A keeps red frills and an upright coiled faint end, and neither side shows its travel role.

top_changes.change: Repaint creature materials to the creature colour board: remove camouflage blotching (Eg, Ln back plates) and red frills (Rp B, Nj A), lift dark bodies (Cb A, Vv) with a value step and rim light so face and eyes read at 30%.

Fix scale and grounding: scale every creature above the 1.80 m trainer (Eg B, Cb), keep faint poses on the floor (Uv B floating, Uv A head through floor) and replace the upright coiled faint end used by Rp B / Nj A with the flat collapse.
Build a real homestead wall piece: thick log or wattle body with textured mid-value infill, a plank cap and a distinct stone footing that tiles into runs, instead of a single thin panel.
